name: Night Rider - Inspired by Bleu de Chanel | Most Formal Perfume for Men
description: Night Rider is the epitome of sophistication and elegance, crafted to leave a lasting impression. Inspired by Bleu de Chanel, this luxurious men's fragrance blends fresh, citrusy top notes with spicy heart notes and warm, woody undertones for an unforgettable scent experience. Ideal for evening events, formal gatherings, or simply making a statement of class and style. Features Premium 42% oil concentration for a luxurious, long-lasting experience Inspired by Bleu de Chanel, embodying elegance and mystery Perfect for evening wear and formal events Fragrance Notes Top Notes: Grapefruit, Lemon, Mint, Pink Pepper Heart Notes: Ginger, Nutmeg, Jasmine Base Notes: Incense, Vetiver, Cedar, Sandalwood Materials & Care Store in a cool, dry place to preserve the fragrance quality. Avoid direct sunlight to maintain freshness. Keep away from excessive heat to ensure the longevity of the scent.
